scope: Welfare institutions within about 25 km of Silverleaf's five campuses (Arusha City, Ilboru, Kijenge, Usa River, Boma Ng'ombe), their published business contacts, funder links, and public parent/guardian enquiries.
readme_notes: Coverage is incomplete: the session's 200-search web budget ran out part-way through, so several wards and villages were never searched by name. Each slice lists what it did not reach on the Search Coverage sheet. Register-only NGOs have no published contact route yet.

Manual spot-check on 23 September 2026: published emails, phones and locations for Ujamaa Children's Home, The Foundation For Tomorrow, Malaika Children's Friends, Selfless Solutions, Tumaini Children's Foundation and Samaritan Village Orphanage all matched their cited pages.
Corrections to the Silverleaf master found in this run: Cradle of Love Children's Home closed in April 2024; Next Life Foundation is a vocational training centre (out of scope).
